title: TcServiceEndpoint
description: Allows the identification of a TC service endpoint in terms of the parameters provided below, derived from the TcServiceEndpoint message of cdds-tc-service.proto. The JSON encoded TcServiceEndpoint is transferred in the tc-endpoint-bin gRPC method metadata when opening a TC endpoint.

endpointName.description: An optional endpoint name to distinguish endpoints; for instance for spacecrafts supporting multiple bands.

serviceVersion.description: The CDDS service version of this service

serviceProvider.description: The name of the service provider organization providing the TC service

terminal.description: The name of the terminal providing the TC service

serviceUser.description: The service user (spacecraft) for which TC shall be delivered

cltu.description: If the cltu field is set to true, the endpoint supports CLTUs.

gvcIds.description: If the GVCIDs field is set, the endpoint supports TC frames conforming to the specified GVCIDs.

ackTimeout.description: Within ack timeout in seconds, the provider shall respond to TelecommandMessage#transmissionRequest message with either TelecommandReport#ack or TelecommandReport#failure

not.description: Indicates the use of the endpoint for uplink of CLTU, or a TC VC when the TC User provides TC frames for transmission (oneof type); the endpoint is requested either for CLTU uplink or for the uplink of TC frames for the specified GVCIDs.
